results.title: Where the Waves Took Her
results.overview: For many, crossing the Mediterranean is their last hope of escaping war, persecution, and hunger. As more and more women are forced to take this deadly route, a midwife is now a permanent member of the crew of a sea rescue ship. While midwife Anne-Katrin takes part in her first mission, survivors recount the horrors of their journey. Their worlds briefly collide before the rescued women step into another uncertain future.

results.title: Small Talk
results.overview: Hoping to launch a career in the luxury world, Charlie enrolls at the last finishing school in Switzerland. Over the course of a summer, women from around the world learn the codes of elegance, etiquette and conversation meant to prepare them for elite social circles. As they refine their gestures and manners, a world of aspiration, discipline and self-transformation gradually unfolds.

results.title: Aanikoobijigan [ancestor/great-grandparent/great-grandchild]
results.overview: Trapped in museum archives, Ancestors bend time and space to find their way home. History, spirituality, and the law collide as tribal repatriation specialists fight to return and rebury Indigenous human remains, offering a revealing look at the still-pervasive worldviews that justified collecting them in the first place.

results.title: Ravioli Oli
results.overview: Russian pop diva Olga Buzova once again trusts the wrong man - Vadim tricks her into buying a loss-making provincial dumpling factory. Olga will have to go to the city of Nizhny Teplyshki to solve the problem and get rid of the unplanned business, but she will face resistance from local residents.

results.title: Edwin: In Technicolor
results.overview: When struggling TV salesman Edwin’s life begins to fall apart, he is forced to navigate and confront the absurdity of his life.

results.title: Agia
results.overview: In the 1990s, Albania's totalitarian regime is coming to an end. Agia, a young woman in a remote village still ruled by rigid codes of honour and silence, is barred from learning her family's craft. In her first act of defiance, she secretly begins mastering the tradition reserved for men. When this plunges her into a wider world, Agia dares to assert not only work and visibility, but also her own desires. Her belated coming of age becomes a quiet rebellion, mirroring that of a nation struggling to redefine itself.

results.title: Earl Grey
results.overview: In a devastated world now ravaged by a memory-erasing mist, an optimistic father desperately tries to get hold of his son, especially when he discovers that the boy is deliberately trying to breathe in the mist in order to forget himself.

results.title: Dracula
results.overview: Experience on stage the story of Jonathan Harker, a young solicitor sent to finalize a deal with a reclusive earl. As he ventures deeper into the mysterious count’s world, terrifying secrets begin to unfold…

results.title: Xul
results.overview: A documentary that traces the life and inexhaustible work of Xul Solar. Through interviews and an exceptional archive, it delves into the universe of this painter, astrologer, musician, inventor, and visionary.

results.title: Night Shift
results.overview: In winter, inside a shipyard, discipline and precision shape the daily routine of a skipper. Ambrogio Beccaria prepares his boat alongside his team, overseeing technical details and final adjustments. Beneath this surface of competence, traces of a past season, a defeat, and an accident quietly persist.  As the days grow shorter and the nights longer, the atmosphere shifts. Concrete labor gives way to a more intimate, nocturnal dimension. Through fragments of memory, archival materials, and abstract imagery, the film drifts between wakefulness and dream, exploring the fragile boundary between control and vulnerability.

results.title: Helden und Herzen: Bayern, Schalke und das unmögliche Tor
results.original_title: Helden und Herzen: Bayern, Schalke und das unmögliche Tor

results.title: The Charlie O'Leary Story
results.overview: Charlie O'Leary, born in Dublin on 1 February 1924, is now 101 years old, and best known for being kitman on the Irish football team which qualified for the European Championships in 1988 and the World Cup in 1990 and 1994.

results.title: Los Pies Dorados de Willy Laez
results.original_title: Los Pies Dorados de Willy Laez
results.overview: A forgotten cumbia legend, Willy Laez, must accept his present self to reclaim the dance floor with his long-lost partner.

results.title: Kengur Is Coming Back Home
results.overview: After a glittering playing career in England, where he played in the Premier League, and a not-so-glamorous coaching stint in London, Kengur returns to Serbia with his dark-skinned fiancée Elektra. He arrives in style, full of plans and patriotic fervor.

results.title: Drury Lane
results.overview: A flat tire leaves realtor James stranded on the side of the road. He’s now at the mercy of a stranger who finds himself on the same road, on the same night, at the same time…

results.title: Felai FX - Trader Gelap: Apa Mau Takut
results.original_title: Felai FX - Trader Gelap: Apa Mau Takut
results.overview: The dark world of cybercrime and illegal gambling, specifically focusing on "scammer" activities involving online gambling and forex (foreign exchange) investments. The plot centres on the high-stakes operations of these criminal syndicates including significant "plot twists" that are expected to surprise audiences.

results.title: Private Restroom
results.overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

results.title: Too Many Cooks
results.overview: A group of desperate musicians must complete favors for prospective band members in order to win a coveted music competition.

results.title: Saba
results.overview: In an abstract and symbolic world where gravity is reversed, a unique bond forms between a grandfather and his grandson. As Saba, the grandfather guides the boy through this surreal reality, a violent storm strikes, tearing one of the ropes anchoring their home - and with it, their life together. After suffering a devastating loss of Saba, the boy embarks on an emotional journey in search of closure. Through a stylized and poetic visual language, the film explores life's fundamental questions: the paths we take, separation from those we love, and the endless effort to find closure, reconcile loss, and move forward.
